set -euo pipefail; AVAIL=$(awk '/MemAvailable:/{print int($2/1024)}' /proc/meminfo); CPU=$(nproc); LOAD=$(awk '{print $1}' /proc/loadavg); echo PRECHECK mem_mb=$AVAIL cpu=$CPU load1=$LOAD; python3 - <<PY
import sys
mem=int('$AVAIL'); cpu=int('$CPU'); load=float('$LOAD')
if mem < 3500 or load > cpu*0.80: raise SystemExit('HOST_ADMISSION_DENY')
PY
BASE=/home/andreas/.claude/skills; DEST=$BASE/gstack; TMP=$BASE/.gstack-install-$$; BAK=$BASE/.gstack-pre-frankenstein-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S); mkdir -p "$BASE"; if [ -e "$DEST" ]; then mv "$DEST" "$BAK"; fi; trap 'rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then rm -rf "$TMP"; if [ -e "$BAK" ] && [ ! -e "$DEST" ]; then mv "$BAK" "$DEST"; fi; fi; exit $rc' EXIT; git clone -q --filter=blob:none --no-checkout https://github.com/garrytan/gstack.git "$TMP"; git -C "$TMP" fetch -q --depth 1 origin e362b0ae2f94afdcb55e37cc4690f9ce55ee5d32; git -C "$TMP" checkout -q --detach e362b0ae2f94afdcb55e37cc4690f9ce55ee5d32; cd "$TMP"; echo SOURCE_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo PACKAGE_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version"); bun install --frozen-lockfile; bun run build; test -x browse/dist/browse; ./browse/dist/browse --help >/dev/null; printf '%s
' e362b0ae2f94afdcb55e37cc4690f9ce55ee5d32 > .frankenstein-pinned-commit; rm -rf .git; mv "$TMP" "$DEST"; trap - EXIT; rm -rf "$BAK" 2>/dev/null || true; echo INSTALLED; node -p "require('$DEST/package.json').version"; sha256sum "$DEST/browse/dist/browse"; file "$DEST/browse/dist/browse"; du -sh "$DEST"
